scope: Games between two of the 18 SWAC/MEAC programs. Every team and every player; no minimum.
change_definition: Each row's change is against the same board as of change_from, the previous week with games. rank_change: positive = moved up, on every board. value_change: this week minus last week; a board's `better` says which direction is good. played_this_week false: the team or player did not play, so the value held and the rank moved only because others did (the opponent-adjusted boards are the exception: an idle team's value moves when its past opponents play). new: not on the board last week. Garbage time in. change is null on a season's first week of games.
garbage_time: value and rank include it, like a box score. The yardage and points boards also carry value_competitive and rank_competitive with it out. Rates come from team analytics as published, with it in.

players.label: Rushing yards per game
players.definition: Rushing yards / games played. Sacks are not rushes.

players.label: Total offense per game
players.definition: Rushing plus passing yards / games played.

players.label: All-purpose yards per game
players.definition: Rushing, receiving and return yards / games played.

players.label: Touchdowns per game
players.definition: Touchdowns scored / games played. Home: this builder.

players.label: Tackles per game
players.definition: Solo plus assisted tackles / games played.

players.label: Interceptions per game
players.definition: Interceptions / games played. Home: this builder.

players.label: Pass breakups per game
players.definition: Pass breakups / games played. Home: this builder.

teams.label: Rushing offense
teams.definition: Rushing yards / games. Sacks are not rushes.

teams.label: Red-zone scoring rate
teams.definition: Red-zone trips with a TD or FG / trips.

teams.label: Red-zone defense
teams.definition: Opponents' red-zone trips with a TD or FG / trips.

teams.label: Turnover margin per game
teams.definition: (Interceptions and opponent lost fumbles) minus (own interceptions and lost fumbles), / games. Home: this builder.

teams.label: EPA per play
teams.definition: Expected points added per offensive play.

teams.label: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play
teams.definition: EPA per play adjusted for opponents.

teams.label: Opponent-adjusted EPA allowed
teams.definition: EPA allowed per play adjusted for opponents.

teams.label: Success rate
teams.definition: 50% of the distance on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, 100% on 3rd or 4th.

teams.label: Explosive play rate
teams.definition: Runs of 12+ and passes of 16+ / plays.

teams.label: Explosive plays allowed
teams.definition: Opponents' runs of 12+ and passes of 16+ / plays.

teams.label: Points per scoring opportunity
teams.definition: Points per drive with a snap at or inside the opponent's 40.

teams.label: Points per opportunity allowed
teams.definition: Opponents' points per drive with a snap at or inside our 40.

teams.label: Havoc rate
teams.definition: Plays with a TFL, sack, forced fumble, pass defensed or interception / plays.
